remarks: Bright and sunny apartment in a well-maintained elevator building. Public records identify this as a 1-bedroom unit, though the flexible layout may also appeal to buyers seeking a studio-style living arrangement. Located on the 3rd floor, this unit features a living room, kitchen, full bath, and excellent storage space. Conveniently located near Downtown Stamford, shopping, restaurants, entertainment, and the train station. Laundry facilities on the main level. Currently rented for $1,700 /month - month to month. HOA includes heat, hot water, and cooking gas. Owner pays HOA fee, tenant only pays electric. Parking is also available in the back parking lot from 5:30pm-7:30am during the week and 24 hours on the weekends. Permit parking is available on Hillcrest Avenue.
